'''Aro-GX Security Droids''' were a model designed by [[Aro (manufacturer)|Aro]]. They were equipped with body armor, [[Wrist blaster/Legends|wrist blasters]], two auto-balance legs, and two arms. They stood 1.8 meters tall and were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in shape. They cost 9,000 credits, but were restricted to governments and militaries. The model was introduced to compete with the [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] made by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] and [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]], but the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] determined the series was "too lethal for commercial sale," a decision seemingly justified when [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] criminals reprogrammed one of the droids, leading to it almost assassinating the [[Diktat]]. The resulting bad publicity put Aro out of business, with the remaining droids ending up on the black market. The model was banned from the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], but many [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]], and [[High Admiral]]s along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] illegally maintained security forces made up of the model. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cragus 12]] owned an Aro-GX designated [[GX-99]].
